factual_claims.claim: Telia Lietuva delivered strong financial growth in the first half of 2026.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Interim service revenue grew by 6.7 per cent, equipment sales revenue increased by 7.2 per cent and interim EBITDA exceeded the threshold of EUR 100 million for the first time while EBITDA margin stood above 40 per cent. Financial highlights show revenue growth of 7.2%, EBITDA increase of 9.5%, and profit growth of 14.7%.

factual_claims.claim: Revenue increased 7.2% year on year to EUR 259.1 million, driven by growth across the main revenue categories.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Financial figures table shows Revenue for January-June 2026: EUR 259,084 thousand (259.084 million), a 7.2% increase from 2025 (EUR 241,674 thousand).

factual_claims.claim: Fixed-services revenue rose 5.3% to EUR 112.9 million, mobile-services revenue increased 8.3% to EUR 100.0 million, and equipment sales grew 9.6% to EUR 46.1 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Revenue breakdown table shows Fixed services H1 2026: EUR 112,920 thousand (112.92 million, +5.3%), Mobile services: EUR 100,022 thousand (100.022 million, +8.3%), Equipment: EUR 46,142 thousand (46.142 million, +9.6%).

factual_claims.claim: IT services were a particularly strong contributor, increasing 23.9% to EUR 19.8 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Revenue breakdown table shows IT services H1 2026: EUR 19,775 thousand (19.775 million), a 23.9% increase from 2025 (EUR 15,959 thousand).

factual_claims.claim: In the second quarter, revenue grew 6.9% to EUR 130.3 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Financial highlights state Q2 2026 revenue: EUR 130.3 million, +6.9% vs 2025. Table confirms April-June 2026 revenue: EUR 130,276 thousand (130.276 million).

factual_claims.claim: Profitability improved faster than revenue.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Revenue growth: 7.2% (H1), EBITDA growth: 9.5% (H1), indicating faster profitability improvement. EBITDA margin rose to 40.7% from 39.9%.

factual_claims.claim: Adjusted EBITDA, excluding non-recurring items, increased 10.2% to EUR 106.9 million, with the margin rising to 41.3% from 40.1%.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Financial highlights state Adjusted EBITDA excluding non-recurring items for H1 2026: EUR 106.9 million (+10.2%), margin 41.3% vs 40.1% in 2025.

factual_claims.claim: Reported EBITDA grew 9.5% to EUR 105.5 million and its margin improved to 40.7% from 39.9%.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Financial figures table shows EBITDA for H1 2026: EUR 105,468 thousand (105.468 million, +9.5%), margin 40.7% vs 39.9% in 2025.

factual_claims.claim: Operating profit increased 15.1% to EUR 62.4 million, while profit before tax rose 16.6% to EUR 61.3 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Financial statements show Operating profit (EBIT) H1 2026: EUR 62,420 thousand (62.42 million, +15.1%), Profit before income tax: EUR 61,277 thousand (61.277 million, +16.6%).

factual_claims.claim: Profit for the period was EUR 51.3 million, up 14.7% from EUR 44.7 million, and earnings per share increased to EUR 0.088 from EUR 0.077.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Financial statements show Profit for the period H1 2026: EUR 51,326 thousand (51.326 million, +14.7%), Basic earnings per share: EUR 0.088 vs EUR 0.077 in 2025.

factual_claims.claim: Second-quarter profit rose 20.6% to EUR 26.7 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Financial highlights state Q2 2026 profit: EUR 26.7 million, +20.6% vs 2025. Table confirms April-June 2026 profit: EUR 26,699 thousand (26.699 million).

factual_claims.claim: Cost of goods and services increased 2.3%, reflecting higher equipment sales volumes and increased network interconnection and roaming costs.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Expenses section states cost of goods and services for H1 2026 increased by 2.3% to EUR 85,522 thousand. The text attributes this to higher equipment sales volumes and increased network interconnection/roaming costs.

factual_claims.claim: Operating expenses excluding non-recurring items rose 10.2%.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Expenses table shows Operating expenses (excl. non-recurring) for H1 2026: EUR 67,323 thousand, a 10.2% increase from 2025 (EUR 61,087 thousand).

factual_claims.claim: Energy expenses increased 14.3%, external IT-service costs rose 18.4%, and expenses for common Group functions also increased.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Expenses section explicitly states: 'During January-June 2026, expenses for energy increased by 14.3 per cent, cost of external IT services went up by 18.4 per cent as well as expenses for common Group function.'

factual_claims.claim: Non-recurring expenses reached EUR 1.4 million, mainly redundancy costs related to restructuring the Digital & Technology unit.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Expenses section states: 'Non-recurring expenses for the first half of 2026 were... EUR 1.4 million (EUR 353 thousand a year ago) and non-recurring other expenses to EUR 31 thousand... Employee related expenses rose mainly due to non-recurring redundancy expenses of EUR 1.4 million related to restructuring of the Company’s Digital & Technology unit.'

factual_claims.claim: Headcount decreased by 86 to 1,601, while full-time employees declined by 93 to 1,524.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: People section states: 'During January-June 2026, the total number of employees (headcount) decreased by 86 – from 1,687 to 1,601. In terms of full-time employees (FTE), the total number of employees decreased by 93 – from 1,617 to 1,524.'

factual_claims.claim: Cash generation strengthened: operating cash flow increased 15.0% to EUR 103.1 million and free cash flow rose 12.5% to EUR 64.1 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Cash flow statement shows Net cash generated by operating activities H1 2026: EUR 103,131 thousand (103.131 million, +15.0%), Free cash flow: EUR 64,099 thousand (64.099 million, +12.5%).

factual_claims.claim: Capital investments increased 57.9% to EUR 37.5 million, including EUR 9.7 million for 5G spectrum licenses, EUR 6.1 million for the mobile network and EUR 14.2 million for IT systems and infrastructure.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Capital investments section states total capital investments for H1 2026: EUR 37,458 thousand (37.458 million, +57.9%). Breakdown: 5G spectrum licenses: EUR 9,690 thousand (9.69 million), Mobile network: EUR 6,116 thousand (6.116 million), IT systems and infrastructure: EUR 14,174 thousand (14.174 million). Minor rounding differences are acceptable.

factual_claims.claim: In June, the company acquired 40 MHz in the 1,500 MHz band for almost EUR 8 million and extended its 2,100 MHz rights for EUR 2 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Capital investments section states: 'In June 2026, the Company acquired two 1,500 MHz frequency blocks for almost EUR 8 million... The Company received the largest share of these frequencies sold – 40 MHz... Telia Lietuva also extended the right to use the 2,100 MHz frequency band in another auction for EUR 2 million.'

factual_claims.claim: These investments support rising mobile data traffic, which the company reports is growing by about 25% annually, as well as planned mobile-network expansion and a new data center investment of up to EUR 26 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: CEO comment states: 'Mobile data traffic in Lithuania is growing by around 25 per cent annually... In 2026, Telia Lietuva will invest EUR 7.1 million in expanding our mobile network... To meet today’s demand and prepare infrastructure for the future technologies at the beginning of 2026 the Company commenced construction of a new Tier III standard data centre near Vilnius. The Company plans to invest up to EUR 26 million into the first two data centre modules.'

factual_claims.claim: The company paid EUR 81.6 million in dividends for 2025.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Dividends section states: 'On 24 April 2026, the Annual General Meeting of Shareholders decided... to allocate EUR 81.6 million for the payment of dividends for the year 2025... The total amount of allocated dividend, that was paid off in May 2026, is EUR 81,566 thousand or EUR 0.14 per ordinary share.'

factual_claims.claim: Despite this distribution, it had no outstanding loans and reported negative net debt of EUR 4.3 million at June-end, compared with positive net debt of EUR 27.5 million a year earlier.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Financial position and cash flow section states: 'As of 30 June 2026, the Company had no outstanding loans... Net debt (30 June 2026): (EUR 4,255 thousand), Net debt (30 June 2025): EUR 27,466 thousand.'

factual_claims.claim: Overall, the first half showed sustained revenue growth, improving margins, stronger profitability and cash generation, alongside significantly higher investment.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: All components of this summary are individually supported by the detailed financial data and analysis presented in the report (revenue growth, margin improvement, profitability increases, cash flow strength, and capital investment growth).
